title: Octen-WebGR: Scaling Generative Retrieval to 200 Million Web Pages
abstract: arXiv:2610.35256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Navigational search aims to find a single target page among hundreds of millions of web pages. Click tables work well for queries seen before but cannot generalise to new formulations, while embedding retrievers generalise across content but often rank navigational targets poorly. We introduce Octen-WebGR, a generative retrieval framework that stores web pages in the parameters of a language model: given a query, the model generates a two-token semantic identifier constrained to a table of real URLs. We develop Octen-WebGR-4B, which indexes 201 million web pages, and evaluate it on real navigational traffic from the month after training. Generative retrieval is most effective on new ways of asking for familiar pages: for unseen queries targeting pages with substantial interaction history, it ranks the correct page first 30.9% of the time, against 17.2% for a dense retriever trained on the same clicks (21.4% with a click prior). translated_title: Octen-WebGR：将生成式检索扩展至2亿网页规模
translated_abstract: 导航搜索旨在从数亿网页中找到唯一的目标页面。点击表对于之前见过的查询效果良好，但无法泛化到新的查询表述；而基于嵌入的检索器虽然能在内容上泛化，但对导航目标的排序往往不佳。我们提出Octen-WebGR，这是一种将网页存储在语言模型参数中的生成式检索框架：给定一个查询，模型生成一个双token语义标识符，该标识符被约束在一个真实URL表中。我们开发了Octen-WebGR-4B，可索引2.01亿个网页，并在训练之后一个月的真实导航流量上进行了评估。生成式检索在用新的表述方式请求熟悉页面时最为有效：对于针对具有大量交互历史的页面的未见查询，它有30.9%的概率将正确页面排在第一位，而在相同点击数据上训练的稠密检索器仅为17.2%（使用点击先验时为21.4%）。嵌入
tldr: Octen-WebGR提出一种生成式检索框架，将2亿网页存储在语言模型参数中，通过生成受URL表约束的双token语义标识符定位真实网页，在未见查询的导航搜索任务上显著超越稠密检索器。
en_tdlr: Octen-WebGR is a generative retrieval framework that stores 200 million web pages in language model parameters, generating two-token semantic identifiers constrained to real URLs, substantially outperforming dense retrievers on unseen navigational queries.
